questions.q: $f(x) = \dfrac{1}{2} - \tan\left(\dfrac{\pi x}{2}\right)$, $-1 < x < 1$ and $g(x) = \sqrt{3 + 4x - 4x^2}$. Find domain of $(f+g)$.
questions.explanation: Domain of $g$ is $[-1/2, 3/2]$ (from $4x^2-4x-3\le 0$) and domain of $f$ is $(-1,1)$; the intersection is $[-1/2, 1)$.

questions.q: Write the set builder form $A = \{-1, 1\}$
options: $A = \{x : x \text{ is a root of the equation } x^2 = 1\}$
$A = \{x : x \text{ is a root of the equation } x^2 + 1 = 0\}$
questions.explanation: $x^2=1$ has exactly the roots $-1$ and $1$, matching set $A$.

If $\begin{vmatrix} 2a & x_1 & y_1 \\ 2b & x_2 & y_2 \\ 2c & x_3 & y_3 \end{vmatrix} = \dfrac{abc}{2} \ne 0$, then the area of the triangle whose vertices are $\left(\dfrac{x_1}{a},\dfrac{y_1}{a}\right), \left(\dfrac{x_2}{b},\dfrac{y_2}{b}\right), \left(\dfrac{x_3}{c},\dfrac{y_3}{c}\right)$ is
questions.explanation: Area $=\dfrac12\left|\det\begin{pmatrix}x_1/a & y_1/a & 1\\ x_2/b & y_2/b & 1\\ x_3/c & y_3/c & 1\end{pmatrix}\right|$, which on scaling rows of the given determinant works out to $\dfrac18$.

questions.q: The shaded region shown in fig. [a triangle with vertices $(0,14)$, $(19,14)$ and the base meeting the x-axis so that the sloped side through $(0,14)$ crosses the x-axis at $(5,0)$] is given by the inequation
questions.explanation: The line through $(0,14)$ and $(5,0)$ is $14x+5y=70$; the shaded triangle above this line and below $y=14$, with $x-y\le5$, matches option (1).

questions.q: $\sim[(-p) \land q]$ is logically equivalent to
questions.explanation: $\sim[(\sim p)\land q] = \sim(\sim p)\lor \sim q = p \lor(\sim q)$ by De Morgan's law. (KEA awarded a grace mark for this question.)

questions.q: The value of $\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{2\sqrt2}{3}\right) + \sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac13\right)$ is equal to
questions.explanation: With $\sin\theta_1=2\sqrt2/3,\cos\theta_1=1/3$ and $\sin\theta_2=1/3,\cos\theta_2=2\sqrt2/3$, $\sin(\theta_1+\theta_2)=8/9+1/9=1$, so the sum is $\pi/2$.

questions.q: If the eccentricity of the hyperbola $\dfrac{x^2}{a^2}-\dfrac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ is $\dfrac54$ and $2x+3y-6=0$ is a focal chord of the hyperbola, then the length of transverse axis is equal to ____
questions.explanation: The line meets the x-axis (focus) at $(3,0)$, so $ae=3 \Rightarrow a=12/5$; transverse axis $=2a=24/5$.

questions.q: If $\vec a = i + 2j + 2k$, $|\vec b| = 5$ and the angle between $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ is $\dfrac{\pi}{6}$, then the area of the triangle formed by these two vectors as two sides is
Let $\vec a = i - 2j + 3k$; if $\vec b$ is a vector such that $\vec a \cdot \vec b = |\vec b|^2$ and $|\vec a - \vec b| = \sqrt7$, then $|\vec b| =$ ____
questions.explanation: $|\vec a-\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2-2\vec a\cdot\vec b+|\vec b|^2=14-2|\vec b|^2+|\vec b|^2=14-|\vec b|^2=7\Rightarrow|\vec b|=\sqrt7$.

questions.q: If direction cosines of a vector of magnitude 3 are $\dfrac23, -\dfrac{a}{3}, \dfrac23$ and $a > 0$, then vector is ____
questions.explanation: Direction cosines satisfy $\left(\frac23\right)^2+\left(\frac a3\right)^2+\left(\frac23\right)^2=1\Rightarrow a=1$; vector $=3\left(\frac23,-\frac13,\frac23\right)=2i-j+2k$. (The printed \"a\" was smudged in the paper, so KEA awarded a grace mark.)

questions.q: Equation of line passing through the point $(2, 3, 1)$ and parallel to the line of intersection of the plane $x - 2y - z + 5 = 0$ and $x + y + 3z = 6$ is
questions.explanation: Direction of the line of intersection $=\vec n_1\times\vec n_2=(1,-2,-1)\times(1,1,3)=(-5,-4,3)$, giving option (2).

questions.explanation: $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=2x+\dfrac{2}{x^3}$; at $x=-1$ this is $-4$, so slope of normal $=-1/(-4)=1/4$.

questions.q: $\int \dfrac{1}{x^2(x^4+1)^{3/4}}\, dx$ is equal to ____
questions.explanation: Differentiating $-(1+x^4)^{1/4}/x$ gives exactly $1/(x^2(1+x^4)^{3/4})$, so this is the antiderivative.

A man takes a step forward with probability 0.4 and one step backward with probability 0.6, then the probability that at the end of eleven steps he is one step away from the starting point is
questions.explanation: He needs 6 forward & 5 backward steps (or 5 forward, 6 backward); $P={}^{11}C_6p^6q^5+{}^{11}C_5p^5q^6={}^{11}C_6(0.4\cdot0.6)^5={}^{11}C_6(0.24)^5$.

questions.q: $\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/4} \log\left(\dfrac{\sin x + \cos x}{\cos x}\right)dx$
questions.explanation: The integral equals $\int_0^{\pi/4}\log(1+\tan x)\,dx$, a standard result equal to $\dfrac{\pi}{8}\log2$.

Let $\vec a = i + 2j + k$, $\vec b = i - j + k$ and $\vec c = i + j - k$; a vector in the plane $\vec a$ and $\vec b$ whose projection on $\vec c$ is $\dfrac{1}{\sqrt3}$ is ____
questions.explanation: A vector $x\vec a+y\vec b$ in the plane must have equal first and third components; only $4i-j+4k$ satisfies this, and its projection on $\vec c$ has magnitude $1/\sqrt3$.

questions.q: The mean deviation from the data $3, 10, 10, 4, 7, 10, 5$ is
questions.explanation: Mean $=49/7=7$; sum of absolute deviations $=4+3+3+3+0+3+2=18$, mean deviation $=18/7\approx2.57$ (option 4). KEA's key also accepted option (1), 3.

questions.explanation: $g'(x)=x^{199}+x^{198}+\cdots+x+1$; at $x=0$ only the constant term $1$ survives.

questions.q: A box contains 6 red marbles numbered from 1 through 6 and 4 white marbles numbered 12 through 15. Find the probability that a marble drawn 'at random' is white and odd numbered.
questions.explanation: White odd-numbered marbles are 13 and 15 (2 marbles) out of 10 total, so $P=2/10=1/5$.

If $\dfrac{(x+1)^2}{x^3+x}=\dfrac{A}{x}+\dfrac{Bx+C}{x^2+1}$, then $\text{cosec}^{-1}\left(\dfrac1A\right)+\cot^{-1}\left(\dfrac1B\right)+\sec^{-1}C =$ ____
questions.explanation: Comparing coefficients gives $A=1, B=0, C=2$; so $\text{cosec}^{-1}1+\cot^{-1}(\infty)+\sec^{-1}2=\dfrac{\pi}{2}+0+\dfrac{\pi}{3}=\dfrac{5\pi}{6}$.

questions.q: The remainder obtained when $1!+2!+3!+\cdots+11!$ is divided by 12 is ____
questions.explanation: For $n\ge4$, $n!$ is divisible by 12, so the remainder is that of $1!+2!+3!=9$.

questions.q: The solution of differential equation $x\dfrac{dy}{dx}+2y=x^2$ is ____
questions.explanation: This is linear with I.F. $x^2$: $yx^2=\int x^3\,dx=\dfrac{x^4}{4}+C_1$, giving $y=\dfrac{x^4+4C_1}{4x^2}$, matching option (4).

questions.q: The solution set of the inequation $\dfrac{x^2+6x-7}{|x+4|} < 0$ is ____
questions.explanation: Since $|x+4|>0$ for $x\ne-4$, the inequality reduces to $(x+7)(x-1)<0$, i.e. $-7<x<1$, excluding $x=-4$: $(-7,-4)\cup(-4,1)$.
